fields.name: seo
fields.label: Page title and search
fields.description: How the site appears in Google results and when shared on WhatsApp or social media.

fields.name: title
fields.label: Page title
fields.description: Shown in the browser tab and as the headline in Google results.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Short description
fields.description: One or two sentences shown under the title in Google results.

fields.name: image
fields.label: Sharing picture
fields.description: The picture shown when the site is shared on social media.

fields.name: general
fields.label: Resort details
fields.description: Name, phone, email, address and booking link. Used across the page.

fields.name: phone
fields.label: Phone number
fields.description: As guests should read it, e.g. +91 72059 70222. The call button uses it too.

fields.name: whatsapp
fields.label: WhatsApp number
fields.description: Digits only with the country code, e.g. 917205970222. Leave empty until the resort has a WhatsApp Business number.

fields.name: bookingUrl
fields.label: Booking page link
fields.description: Where "Book direct" and "Check availability" send guests. Leave empty to send them to the enquiry form instead.

fields.name: checkIn
fields.label: Check-in time
fields.description: e.g. 12 PM

fields.name: checkOut
fields.label: Check-out time
fields.description: e.g. 10 AM

fields.name: buttons
fields.label: Button wording
fields.description: The words on the main buttons that appear in several places.

fields.name: nav
fields.label: Menu
fields.description: The words in the top menu and footer. The menu always links to the same sections of the page.

fields.name: hero
fields.label: Opening screen
fields.description: The pictures and films that change by themselves at the very top of the page.

fields.name: slides
fields.label: Slides
fields.description: Each slide has a picture or a film and one line of large text. Slides play in this order, morning into night.

fields.name: title

fields.description: The first words of the caption

fields.name: alt
fields.label: Describe the picture
fields.description: Read aloud to guests who cannot see it, and used by Google.

fields.name: poster
